from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace')
programs=root/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
